_format: Numbers written {base|upgraded}. cost_up = cost after upgrade. up = other upgrade changes. arch: Wall, Deport, Deals, Tweets, General. mp = co-op only (MultiplayerConstraint). v2 = construction-project Wall + %-based Deport (2026-09-23).

cards.name: Strike
cards.text: Deal {6|9} damage.
cards.art: Donald throws a wild haymaker, tie flapping.

cards.name: Defend
cards.text: Gain {5|8} Block.
cards.art: Donald hides behind a podium stacked with binders.

cards.name: Build the Wall
cards.text: Build {5|8}.
cards.art: Donald proudly slaps a gold-trimmed brick onto a growing wall.
cards.note: Turn 1 with the Golden Shovel: 2 + 5 = 7. The shovel's 2 per turn finishes the first Section by turn 3 even without another Build.

cards.name: Deport
cards.text: Deal {6|9} damage. Deport.
cards.art: A startled cultist shoved through a turnstile marked EXIT.
cards.note: Strike + the signature clause. A 30 HP enemy at 13 HP is hit to 7 and Deported (25% line = 7.5).

cards.name: Brick Toss
cards.text: Deal {7|9} damage. Build {3|5}.
cards.art: A golden brick bonks a beetle on the head.
cards.note: Iron Wave equivalent.

cards.name: Wall Slam
cards.text: Deal damage equal to half your Wall.
cards.art: Donald shoulder-checks an enemy into his own wall.
cards.note: Body Slam for the Wall. Repeatable and uncapped: the Wall only grows.

cards.name: Escort Out
cards.text: Deal {14|18} damage. Deport.
cards.art: Two burly security guards carry a flailing slime by the elbows.

cards.name: Show Them the Door
cards.text: Deal {4|5} damage twice. Deport.
cards.art: Donald holding a door open with a flourish; a goblin slinks out.

cards.name: Slap a Tariff
cards.text: Deal {8|10} damage. Apply {2|3} Tariff.
cards.art: A price tag slapped onto a monster's forehead.

cards.name: Hostile Takeover
cards.text: Deal {9|12} damage. If Fatal, gain {12|15} Gold.
cards.art: Donald plants a SOLD sign on a toppled foe.
cards.note: Deport is not Fatal: kill for gold or Deport for tempo.

cards.name: Mean Tweet
cards.text: Deal {6|9} damage. Add a Tweet into your Hand.
cards.art: A phone screen full of angry caps-lock, a tiny monster crying.

cards.name: ALL CAPS
cards.text: Deal {3|4} damage to ALL enemies twice.
cards.art: Giant block letters crash down on a crowd of enemies.

cards.name: Sad!
cards.text: Deal {8|10} damage. Apply {1|2} Weak.
cards.art: An enemy slumps, a tiny rain cloud over its head.

cards.name: Mulligan
cards.text: Deal {9|12} damage. Discard 1 card, then draw 1 card.
cards.art: Donald nudging a golf ball out of the rough with his shoe.
cards.note: Discard triggers Sly cards.

cards.name: Power Handshake
cards.text: Deal {7|9} damage. Apply {1|2} Vulnerable.
cards.art: A white-knuckle handshake yanking an enemy off balance.

cards.name: Bricklayer
cards.text: Build {6|8}. Draw 1 card.
cards.art: Donald in a hard hat over his suit, trowel in hand.
cards.note: Shrug It Off equivalent.

cards.name: Groundbreaking
cards.text: Build {3|5}. Draw 1 card.
cards.art: A golden shovel stuck in the dirt, a ribbon, a crowd of photographers.
cards.note: Free cycling for Wall decks.

cards.name: Pour Concrete
cards.art: A gold cement mixer pouring into wall forms.

cards.name: Barbed Wire
cards.text: Build {4|6}. This turn, whenever you are attacked, deal {2|3} damage back, plus 1 for each Section.
cards.art: Coils of gilded razor wire on the wall top.

cards.name: Late-Night Posting
cards.text: Add {2|3} Tweets into your Hand.
cards.art: Donald in bed at 3 AM, face lit by his phone.

cards.name: Campaign Donation
cards.text: Gain {8|12} Gold. Draw 1 card.
cards.art: A donation jar overflowing with Spire coins.

cards.name: Small Loan
cards.text: Pay 10 Gold. Gain 1 Energy. Draw {1|2} card(s).
cards.art: A 'small loan' check with far too many zeros.
cards.note: Bloodletting-style: gold instead of HP.

cards.name: Low Energy
cards.text: ALL enemies lose {3|5} Strength this turn.
cards.art: Donald yawning theatrically at a row of drooping monsters.

cards.name: Alternative Facts
cards.text: Gain {7|10} Block. Put a card from your Discard Pile into your Hand.
cards.art: Donald holding up a chart that was clearly redrawn in marker.

cards.name: Border Patrol
cards.text: Deal {7|10} damage to ALL enemies. Deport ALL.
cards.art: Searchlights sweep across the wall; silhouettes scatter.

cards.name: One-Way Ticket
cards.text: Deal {9|12} damage. Deport. If it was Deported, draw 2 cards.
cards.art: A golden plane ticket stuffed into a fleeing monster's mouth.

cards.name: Demolition
cards.text: Deal damage equal to your Wall. Lose half your Wall.
cards.art: Donald in a hard hat pushing a big red DEMOLISH plunger.
cards.note: Stages you've reached stay unlocked, so tearing down and rebuilding is a real plan.

cards.name: Trade War
cards.text: Deal {5|7} damage to ALL enemies. Apply {2|3} Tariff to ALL enemies.
cards.art: Shipping crates hurled across the battlefield.

cards.name: Net Worth
cards.text: Deal 5 damage, plus 1 for every 10 Gold you have.
cards.art: A falling golden safe with a dollar sign.
cards.note: 200 Gold = 25 damage.

cards.name: Going Viral
cards.text: Deal {3|4} damage for each Tweet played this combat.
cards.art: A tidal wave of retweet icons.

cards.name: Fire and Fury
cards.text: Deal {5|8} damage to ALL enemies X times.
cards.art: Donald at a podium, flames behind him, finger jabbing.
cards.note: Whirlwind.

cards.name: Bigly
cards.text: Deal {11|14} damage. Increase this card's damage by {6|8} this combat.
cards.art: Donald's fist getting comically larger in three panels.
cards.note: Rampage.

cards.name: Witch Hunt
cards.text: Deal {8|10} damage. If the enemy is Weak, hits twice.
cards.art: A pitchfork mob of cardboard cutouts, led by Donald.

cards.name: Security Detail
cards.text: Deal {12|15} damage. Build {8|11}.
cards.art: Sunglasses-wearing guards form a human wall.

cards.name: Rally Speech
cards.text: Deal {5|7} damage to ALL enemies. Add a Tweet into your Hand.
cards.art: A roaring crowd, Donald doing the accordion hands.

cards.name: Ten Feet Higher
cards.text: Build {5|7}. If your Wall is 25 or more, Build {5|7} more.
cards.art: A ladder that can't reach the top of the wall.

cards.name: Hold the Line
cards.text: Gain Block equal to half your Wall.
cards.art: Donald bracing against the wall with both hands.

cards.name: Background Check
cards.text: Enemy loses {7|10} HP. Deport.
cards.art: A magnifying glass over a sweating monster's paperwork.
cards.note: HP loss ignores Block, so it reaches block-stacking enemies.

cards.name: Hire Contractors
cards.text: Pay 20 Gold. Build {14|18}.
cards.art: A crew of goblin builders counting coins.

cards.name: Bribe
cards.text: Pay {20|15} Gold. Gain 2 Energy.
cards.art: A briefcase of gold slid across a table.

cards.name: Wall Street
cards.text: Gain {4|6} Gold for each Section.
cards.art: A stock ticker running along the top of the wall.
cards.note: Bridges Wall and Deals.

cards.name: Casino
cards.text: Pay 10 Gold. Draw {3|4} cards.
cards.art: A slot machine paying out in cards.

cards.name: Tweetstorm
cards.text: Add X+1 Tweets into your Hand.
cards.art: A swirling cyclone of phones and speech bubbles.

cards.name: Blocked!
cards.text: This turn, whenever you play a Tweet, gain {4|6} Block. Add a Tweet into your Hand.
cards.art: A giant BLOCK button being slammed.

cards.name: Doomscrolling
cards.text: Draw {3|4} cards. Add a Tweet into your Hand.
cards.art: Donald's face lit blue, thumb blurred from scrolling.

cards.name: Covfefe
cards.text: Add a random Colorless card into your Hand. It costs 0 this turn.
cards.art: A coffee cup with the word misspelled; nobody knows what's inside.

cards.name: Two Scoops
cards.text: Gain 2 Energy.
cards.art: A tall bowl of ice cream: two scoops for him, one for everyone else.

cards.name: Sharpie
cards.text: Enemy loses {6|9} Strength this turn. Draw 1 card.
cards.art: Donald redrawing an enemy's attack arrow with a marker.

cards.name: Executive Time
cards.text: Draw {2|3} cards. Next turn, gain 1 Energy.
cards.art: Feet up on the Resolute desk, TV remote in hand.

cards.name: Fake News
cards.text: Apply {2|3} Weak. Apply {2|3} Vulnerable.
cards.art: A newspaper stamped FAKE smacks an enemy in the face.
cards.note: Putrefy equivalent.

cards.name: Trickle Down
cards.text: ALL players gain {12|18} Gold.
cards.art: Coins dribbling down a champagne tower onto allies.

cards.name: Rebar
cards.text: At the start of your turn, Build {3|4}.
cards.art: Steel rods sticking out of the wall's top.

cards.name: Guard Towers
cards.text: At the end of your turn, deal {2|3} damage to a random enemy for each Section.
cards.art: Gold guard towers along the wall, each with a spotlight and a slingshot.
cards.note: The Wall deck's main damage engine; copies stack.

cards.name: Border Control
cards.text: Your Deport line is {10|15}% higher.
cards.art: A control room of monitors watching the border.
cards.note: Stacks: two copies take the line from 25% to 45%.

cards.name: Border Wall
cards.text: Your Deport line is {2|3}% higher for each Section.
cards.art: The wall with a huge DEPORT arrow painted along it.
cards.note: Bridges Wall and Deport; neither needs the other.

cards.name: Protectionism
cards.text: At the start of your turn, apply 1 Tariff to ALL enemies.
cards.art: Donald hugging a pile of gold like a dragon.

cards.name: Merch Stand
cards.text: At the end of combat, gain {15|22} Gold.
cards.art: A folding table of red caps and gold sneakers.
cards.note: Half of Regent's Rare Royalties (30).

cards.name: Social Media Intern
cards.text: At the start of your turn, add a Tweet into your Hand.
cards.art: A nervous goblin intern typing on three phones.

cards.name: Ratings
cards.text: Whenever you play a Tweet, Build {2|3}.
cards.art: A TV ratings chart going straight up.
cards.note: Bridges Tweets and Wall.

cards.name: Executive Order
cards.text: The first Skill you play each turn costs 0.
cards.art: Donald holding up a signed folder to cameras.

cards.name: Wrecking Ball
cards.text: Deal damage equal to your Wall to ALL enemies. Lose half your Wall.
cards.art: A gold wrecking ball swinging through a whole line of enemies.

cards.name: Cornerstone
cards.text: Deal {8|11} damage. Build 3. If Fatal, permanently increase this card's Build by 3.
cards.art: A gold plaque reading 'This wall was built by the greatest builder ever'.
cards.note: Run-long scaling like Feed or The Scythe: the Wall starts higher every fight.

cards.name: Mass Deportation
cards.text: Deal {10|14} damage to ALL enemies. Deport ALL, with your Deport line doubled.
cards.art: A fleet of gold buses with EXIT on the destination signs.

cards.name: Tariff Man
cards.text: Deal {12|16} damage. Double the enemy's Tariff.
cards.art: Donald flexing in a superhero cape labeled TARIFF MAN.

cards.name: Leveraged Buyout
cards.text: Deal {20|26} damage. If Fatal, gain 40 Gold.
cards.art: A giant contract crushing an enemy under its fine print.
cards.note: Feed, but Gold instead of Max HP.

cards.name: Make It Rain
cards.text: Pay 25 Gold. Deal {7|9} damage to ALL enemies 3 times.
cards.art: Gold coins raining from the sky like hail.

cards.name: Trending
cards.text: Deal {3|5} damage to ALL enemies. Whenever you play a Tweet, return this to your Hand from the Discard Pile.
cards.art: A #1 trending badge hovering over the battlefield.

cards.name: Hole in One
cards.text: Can only be played as the first card each turn. Deal {14|20} damage.
cards.art: A golf ball ricocheting off three monsters into a cup.

cards.name: You're Fired!
cards.text: Pay {99|75} Gold. Deport the enemy, whatever its HP. (Not Bosses.)
cards.art: The iconic boardroom point; an elite monster packing a cardboard box.
cards.note: Turns Gold into skipping the rest of a non-boss fight. Still no Gold from that enemy.

cards.name: Great Wall
cards.text: Double your Wall.
cards.art: The wall stretching to the horizon, bigger than the Spire itself.

cards.name: Chapter 11
cards.text: Lose all your Gold. Gain 1 Block for every {4|3} Gold lost.
cards.art: Donald cheerfully tossing an empty wallet over his shoulder.
cards.note: Emergency button: 300 Gold = 75 Block.

cards.name: Lawyer Up
cards.text: Pay {40|30} Gold. Gain 1 Intangible.
cards.art: A wall of lawyers in identical suits absorbing a blow.

cards.name: Golf Weekend
cards.text: End your turn. Next turn, gain 2 Energy and draw {2|3} cards.
cards.art: A golf cart parked in the middle of a battle; Donald teeing off.

cards.name: Burner Accounts
cards.text: Add {4|5} Upgraded Tweets into your Hand.
cards.art: A table covered in cheap phones with fake-mustache profile pics.

cards.name: Very Stable Genius
cards.text: Upgrade ALL cards in your Hand for the rest of combat. Draw 2 cards.
cards.art: Donald balancing a stack of books on his head, very steady.

cards.name: Coalition Wall
cards.text: ALL players Build {12|16}.
cards.art: The whole party laying bricks side by side.

cards.name: National Emergency
cards.text: Build equal to the total damage enemies intend to deal this turn.
cards.art: Red sirens, a declaration signed with a flourish, the wall shooting up.

cards.name: They'll Pay For It
cards.text: Whenever an enemy attacks you and deals no damage to your HP, gain {4|6} Gold.
cards.art: Enemies grudgingly stuffing coins into a toll box on the wall.
cards.note: Section Block + this = the wall pays for itself.

cards.name: Infrastructure Week
cards.text: At the start of your turn, Build {7|10}.
cards.art: A banner reading INFRASTRUCTURE WEEK, week 47.
cards.note: Demon Form for the Wall.

cards.name: Reinforced Concrete
cards.text: Each Section gives {2|3} more Block.
cards.art: Steel rebar sticking out of fresh concrete with a gold trowel.
cards.note: Copies stack: the Wall's defense has no ceiling.

cards.name: Law and Order
cards.text: At the end of your turn, Deport ALL enemies.
cards.art: A gavel the size of a door slamming down.
cards.note: Automatic Deport check every turn; bosses stay immune.

cards.name: The Art of the Deal
cards.text: Whenever you Pay Gold, draw 1 card.
cards.art: Donald holding up his book with a smug grin.

cards.name: Gold Tower
cards.text: At the end of your turn, gain 1 Block for every {15|10} Gold you have.
cards.art: A gleaming gold skyscraper rising behind Donald.

cards.name: So Much Winning
cards.text: Whenever an enemy dies or is Deported, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 card.
cards.art: Donald on a podium buried in trophies, looking bored of winning.

cards.name: Verified Account
cards.text: Tweets deal {3|5} additional damage.
cards.art: A gold checkmark badge the size of a shield.

cards.name: 3 AM Posting
cards.text: At the start of your turn, add {2|3} Tweets into your Hand.
cards.art: A moonlit bedroom, the phone glowing like a lighthouse.

cards.name: Golden Escalator
cards.text: Deal {16|22} damage to ALL enemies. Build {16|22}.
cards.art: Donald descending a golden escalator as the enemies are blasted back by the glare.
cards.note: Ancient attacks: Break (20 + 5 Vulnerable), Meteor Shower (14 AoE + debuffs).

cards.name: Make the Spire Great Again
cards.text: At the start of your turn, Build 4, gain 4 Gold and add a Tweet into your Hand.
cards.art: The Spire wearing a giant red cap.
cards.note: Feeds every play style at once.

cards.name: Tweet
cards.text: Deal {3|5} damage to ALL enemies.
cards.art: A single angry speech bubble with a tiny bird silhouette.

relics.name: Golden Shovel
relics.text: At the start of your turn, Build 2.
relics.flavor: The crew never stops digging. The shovel mostly supervises.

relics.name: Diamond Shovel
relics.text: At the start of your turn, Build 4.
relics.flavor: Replaces Golden Shovel via Touch of Orobas. Nobody has ever seen a shovel like it.

relics.name: Long Red Tie
relics.text: Whenever you Deport an enemy, gain 1 Energy.
relics.flavor: Reaches well past the belt. On purpose.

relics.name: Gold-Plated Bricks
relics.text: At the end of combat, gain 2 Gold for each Section of your Wall.

relics.name: Rubber Stamp
relics.text: Deported enemies still drop their Gold.
relics.flavor: It only has one word on it.

relics.name: Permanent Structure
relics.text: At the end of combat, keep a quarter of your Wall. Start the next combat with it.

relics.name: Late-Night Phone
relics.text: The first Tweet you play each turn is played twice.

relics.name: Gold-Plated Toilet
relics.text: At the start of your turn, if you have 250 or more Gold, gain 1 Energy.
relics.flavor: The merchant swears it's never been used.

potions.name: Covfefe
potions.text: Add 3 Upgraded Tweets into your Hand.

potions.name: Deportation Draught
potions.text: Deport an enemy, whatever its HP. (Not Bosses.)
